terms.definition: A metal in the central block of the periodic table, such as Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu.
Compared with Group 1: higher melting points (except mercury), higher density, stronger, harder and much less reactive.
Transition metals form ions with different charges and coloured compounds.
terms.examiner: Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ are both iron ions.

terms.definition: Many transition metals and their compounds are useful catalysts, such as iron in the Haber process.
